name: dropdown-menu-item
title: Dropdown Menu Item
description: A menu row: a pointer hovers it and presses it, inside a small action menu.
useWhen: A menu demo needs a single row's hover and press feedback.
Explaining how menu actions respond to the pointer.
avoidWhen: The whole menu opening and acting is wanted: use dropdown-menu.
A row that stays selected: use select-item.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Other rows
variables.description: Comma-separated rows shown idle around it.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
